investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Tapcrest Press (news and media publishing); Platform: Microsoft Azure eastus2 (zones eastus2-1/eastus2-2/eastus2-3); network range 10.144.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster tapcre-prod-eastus (AKS); content-api pods run with 8 GiB memory limits; deployments are canary releases with automated analysis; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
